scores.tell: Moon-surface ground with many rocks and craters plus a sunburst: busier than real cards' quiet few-shape environments; rover has extra small props (dish, panel, rivets).
Plain cyan field with two fence rails behind the saddle, matching the real saddle card. Nothing busy.
Quiet tone-on-tone pi pattern on a soft yellow field. Matches the real towel and whistle cards. Pattern is a little dense but low contrast.
Orange pi pattern is slightly higher-contrast and denser than the quiet reference patterns. Otherwise a flat graphic field with a glow.
none. Quiet concentric rings on a flat field, as in the real glass card.
Magenta diamond-pattern backdrop and flat pink ledge are quiet. The stone border ring and many flowers make the hero busy, but the background itself is fine.
Busy scene: bubbles, sand, a shell, loose coins and a gradient water backdrop. Many secondary props that crowd the hero.
Quiet purple concentric rings on a flat field. The earbud cord is part of the object. Nothing extra.

Full outdoor meadow with trees, bushes, clouds, grass tufts and a purple lining. The environment is much busier than real cards and the cross is a story-like prop. The real swing card is similar but has larger, quieter shapes.
Quiet green rings on a flat field, which is good. The hero carries many small invented props (photos, boat, houses, stamp, postmark) that add story load.
